title: MiniMax H3 Image: 16 reference images in, 4K output in about 10 seconds, live on fal and Runware
summary: MiniMax's image model built on H3 supports edits with up to 16 references and up to 20 MP output, with a Highspeed variant at 2x speed, available through fal and Runware APIs on day 0. Runware describes it as open-weight.
